import sys
sys.path.insert\(0, '/Users/anishgupta/Desktop/ChatGIT'\)
from chatgit.core.chunker import chunk_repository

docs = chunk_repository\("/tmp/flask_bench"\)

# Build chunk index: file::node_name -> text
chunk_index = {}
for d in docs:
    cid = f"{d.metadata['file_name']}::{d.metadata['node_name']}"
    chunk_index[cid] = d.page_content if hasattr\(d, 'page_content'\) else d.text

# Check if our GT chunk IDs from sample_conversations.jsonl match
gt_ids = [
    "src/flask/app.py::Flask",
    "src/flask/app.py::Flask.add_url_rule",
    "src/flask/app.py::Flask.handle_exception",
    "src/flask/app.py::Flask.handle_http_exception",
    "src/flask/sansio/app.py::App.add_url_rule",
    "src/flask/blueprints.py::Blueprint",
    "src/flask/sansio/blueprints.py::BlueprintSetupState",
    "src/flask/sansio/app.py::App._find_error_handler",
]

print\("Ground truth chunk ID matching:"\)
for gid in gt_ids:
    found = gid in chunk_index
    # Try partial match
    if not found:
        partial = [k for k in chunk_index if gid.split\("::"\)[-1] in k]
        print\(f"  {'✓' if found else '~'} {gid}  {'FOUND' if found else f'PARTIAL: {partial[:2]}'}"\)
    else:
        print\(f"  ✓ {gid}  FOUND"\)
EOF)
